question.text: Accumulated losses (other than business loss) at investment fund level as on March 31, 2019:

answer.text: Are deemed as losses in the hands of unit holders on March 31, 2019 (carryforward for 8 years)

explanation.text: The Logic: Accumulated losses (other than business loss) at investment-fund level as on March 31, 2019 are deemed to be losses of a unit holder who held units in the fund as on March 31, 2019, in respect of that holder's investment, and may be carried forward. The Trap: "Written off", "passed to Sponsor" and "taxed at 30%" are not the prescribed treatment of these accumulated losses. Note: The carry-forward is allowed until the expiry of 8 years from the year in which the loss was first incurred by the investment fund.
